Simulate Multi-Network Robustness Under Random and Targeted Node Attacks

Source: R/stat_network_robustness.R
cli_network_robustness.Rd

Simulates cascading collapse or progressive degradation of biological networks across conditions, treatments, or cohorts (e.g. KO vs WT vs OE). Tests resilience under:

  • "random": Random species or gene loss (simulated across Monte Carlo permutations).

  • "degree": Targeted attacks removing highest-degree hub nodes first.

  • "betweenness": Targeted attacks removing critical network bottleneck nodes first.

Tracks remaining active node fraction, spectral natural connectivity, or giant component size across progressive node removal fractions.

Usage

cli_network_robustness(
  networks,
  attack = c("random", "degree"),
  rm_fractions = seq(0.05, 0.9, by = 0.05),
  metric = c("natural_connectivity", "remain_nodes", "giant_component"),
  n_perm = 30,
  threshold = 0.3,
  seed = 42
)

Arguments

networks

Named list of square numeric adjacency/correlation matrices, or a single numeric matrix. Names correspond to condition/cohort labels (e.g. list(KO = mat1, WT = mat2)).

attack

Character vector specifying attack types: "random", "degree", and/or "betweenness". Default c("random", "degree").

rm_fractions

Numeric vector of node removal fractions from 0.05 to 0.95 (default seq(0.05, 0.90, by = 0.05)).

metric

Metric to monitor: "natural_connectivity" (default), "remain_nodes" (fraction of nodes with at least 1 edge), or "giant_component" (relative size of largest connected component).

n_perm

Integer. Number of permutations for random removal (default 30).

threshold

Numeric edge threshold to binarize correlation matrices (default 0.3).

seed

Optional integer seed for reproducibility.

Value

A tidy data frame with columns:

  • group: Network condition name.

  • attack: Attack type ("random", "degree", or "betweenness").

  • fraction_removed: Proportion of nodes deleted.

  • value: Mean value of the evaluation metric.

  • se: Standard error (non-zero for random removal).
